_comment: The Tools (connections) step of /jarvis-setup. One entry per external tool or MCP server the page can install or connect. This file is an ALLOWLIST: setup/server.mjs never takes a package name, URL or command from the browser, only an id that must exist here. kind: cli = a binary on PATH, app = a desktop app (also detected by app bundle), mcp = an MCP server added with `claude mcp add -s user`, repo = a git repo cloned with `gh repo clone`. detect: {command} / {app} / {mcp} / {dir}. install (cli/app only): any subset of brew (args after `brew`), winget (package id), npm (args after `npm install`), pip (package), url (manual download page). Installs never run apt/dnf/sudo; those become a copyable line. mcp: {transport:http,url,header_secret} or {transport:stdio,command[]}. secret: only when header_secret is true. Every URL here is a vendor's own endpoint or download page.

tools.name: Context7
tools.why: Live, up-to-date documentation for any library, so answers are not based on stale memory.

tools.name: Playwright browser
tools.why: Lets Claude drive a real browser: open pages, click, fill forms, take screenshots.

tools.name: GitHub CLI
tools.why: Work with GitHub from Claude: clone repos, open pull requests, read issues.
tools.after: Sign in once: gh auth login

tools.name: git
tools.why: Keeps a history of your memory folder, so nothing you save is ever lost.

tools.name: qmd search
tools.why: Search everything you have written, by meaning and by keyword, on your own machine.

tools.name: Defuddle
tools.why: Turns a web page into clean readable text, so Claude reads the article and not the clutter.

tools.name: NotebookLM
tools.why: Deep research with cited answers across the sources you give it.

tools.name: ffmpeg
tools.why: Processes video and audio: convert, trim, extract sound, transcribe voice notes.

tools.name: Obsidian
tools.why: Read your memory folder as linked notes, with search and a graph view.

tools.name: Supabase
tools.why: Let Claude look at and work with your databases.
tools.after: Sign in the first time you use it: type /mcp in Claude Code

tools.name: Vercel
tools.why: Deploy websites and apps straight from Claude.
